title: Multinuclear rare-earth metal complexes supported by chalcogen-based 1,2,3-triazole

synthesis.procedure: Under a dry, oxygen-free N2 atmosphere using Schlenk-line and glovebox techniques, a suspension of YCp3 (0.142 g, 0.50 mmol) in toluene (10 mL) was added dropwise to a solution of LH (1) (0.30 g, 0.50 mmol) in THF (10 mL). The mixture was stirred for 12 h and filtered. The solvent was removed under vacuum and the pale yellow solid was washed with hexane (3 × 5 mL).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk-line/glovebox; dropwise addition then stirring and filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered to remove insolubles; solvent removed under vacuum; pale yellow solid washed with hexane (3 × 5 mL).

synthesis.procedure: Under N2 Schlenk/glovebox conditions, a suspension of YCp3 (0.108 g, 0.38 mmol) in toluene (10 mL) was added dropwise to a suspension of 1 (0.30 g, 0.50 mmol) in toluene (10 mL). After 2 h the mixture turned transparent, and a 0.50 M solution of H2O in THF (0.25 mL, 0.125 mmol) was added at −30 °C. The mixture was warmed to ambient temperature and stirred for 12 h, then filtered and concentrated to 10 mL.

reagents.name: water
reagents.amount: 0.25 mL of 0.50 M THF solution, 0.125 mmol

synthesis.temperature: H2O added at −30 °C, then ambient temperature; crystallization at −30 °C
synthesis.time: 2 h then 12 h stirring; 48 h crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk-line/glovebox; dropwise addition and low-temperature hydrolysis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered and concentrated to 10 mL; stored at −30 °C for 48 h to give colorless crystals, filtered under vacuum.
